G70-0007.text: there are software glitches in idrive 8. hopefully you will give your customers an upgrade to 8.5.

G70-0009.text:
What is the primary reason for your nps rating?
: "Battery charging does not increase the mileage range much. BMW still has not resolved the problems with Apple Car Play."

G70-0051.text: the 7 series has been my dream car for years, so finally buying one felt like a huge milestone for me. unfortunately the car has been plagued with problems since day one, really disappointing.

G70-0090.text: Customer stated bluetooth only seems to function part of the time. Writer asked about the phone. Customer confirmed using an iPhone 15 with CarPlay and that it was just updated. Writer advised removing the phone from the vehicle, the vehicle from the phone, rebooting both, then pairing again as a fresh connection. Customer confirmed.

G70-0103.text: Customer reported a single occurrence where the infotainment display shut off and went black. Customer stated the problem cleared by itself and the screen returned to normal after he restarted the vehicle. Customer stated the issue has not happened again and he has not contacted his dealer about it.

G70-0108.text: Customer stated that when she is using CarPlay, there are times she cannot skip tracks on Pandora and then the app will disconnect completely. Writer offered to help troubleshoot the concern, but customer stated she was heading into an appointment. Writer advised that troubleshooting instructions would be sent by email. Customer is using an iPhone XR on ios 18, and her carrier is AT&T.

G70-0125.text: Customer stated that CarPlay frequently fails to work. Writer confirmed the customer is using an iPhone 14 PRO Max on AT&T with software version 16.4. Writer advised rebooting the phone by fully powering it off and turning it back on, and also suggested un-pairing the phone, removing it from iDrive, then pairing again. Writer recommended restarting the iDrive by holding the radio power button for 30 seconds. Customer stated he has already performed those troubleshooting steps. Writer then suggested a one-time hard reboot of iDrive by holding the button for 70 seconds and recommended a visit to the dealership. Customer stated that when CarPlay acts up, he can still listen to music. Customer stated CarPlay sometimes does not appear, that the phone shows up but CarPlay is missing, and at other times he cannot select the CarPlay checkbox. Customer stated that when he cannot check the CarPlay box, he is also unable to delete the phone from iDrive. Customer stated CarPlay does work properly on some occasions.

G70-0136.text: Customer stated the front cabin storage space is limited, especially compared to his BMW X3, X5, and X7. Customer stated he cannot find a proper place for his sunglasses, keys, wallet, etc.

G70-0141.text: Customer reported having issues with navigation use. Writer offered steps to troubleshoot, which the customer declined, stating he will sort it out on his own.

G70-0174.text: Customer reported he is struggling to change where the air flow is directed.

G70-0175.text: Customer asked how to get cruise control going again after he steps on the brakes. Writer advised him to press the on/off button marked with the 1 and 0. Customer acknowledged this instruction.

G70-0203.text: Customer stated the vehicle is currently at the dealership because of a check engine light. Customer stated he is out of town, so he is not sure what the problem is this time.

G70-0234.text: this car will not suit everyone. the ride is smooth and quiet, the seats and audio are excellent, and the fuel economy and performance are impressive for such a large vehicle. the accent lighting is something I truly enjoy. the downside is the slightly isolated feel of the ride and some tech that comes across as intrusive. the accelerator pedal has a bit of a sticky feel, and the wave-your-foot trunk opener hardly ever works. the nav system is dreadful. it does not seem set up for americans, and its guidance is often inconsistent and wrong: saying "bear left" when there is no reason, then not saying it when there should be; sending me onto blocked or unfinished roads even though the map later shows them as blocked; telling me to stay on the same road ahead when nothing is actually changing; using bear left/right when you are really turning onto a different road and it should say "turn left onto...". it also does not announce when it is rerouting. there is better technology out there.

G70-0243.text: I had a minor problem with Check "engine/motor" light indicated problem: ""Check engine light came on" - service reported that "Fault D34420 would cause the check engine light to illuminate"; the fault was then cleared."

G70-0256.text: Customer asked about using Sport Mode together with the booster. Writer explained Sport Mode applies the most aggressive setup. Writer added that, while moving, pressing the Boost button delivers a strong, time-limited boost to the engine.

G70-0267.text: Customer stated the owner's manual is so detailed that it is somewhat overwhelming, and he is having trouble finding specific information in it.

G70-0268.text: i am not happy with the interior quality, there are just too many electronic controls. the air conditioning vents are a very poor design, and there is a lot of wind noise once you go over about 70 miles an hour. the exterior door handles feel cheap. the whole appearance of the car doesnt really flow, with a truck like front end and a very plain rear. i would not purchase this again and honestly i want to sell it.

G70-0310.text: Customer stated the Owner's Manual is hard to follow and not straightforward to understand.

G70-0311.text: Customer stated IPA had stopped functioning, but after completing an iDrive reset it started working normally again.

G70-0320.text: Customer asked whether, when using the screen, the driver seat is kept from contacting the Theater Screen. Writer confirmed that it does.

G70-0330.text: Connection between Pandora and the iPhone 16. That is the one thing could be most improved about the infotainment system in my vehicle.

G70-0348.text: Customer stated they would like all of the sensors to automatically switch off when Car wash mode is turned on.

G70-0356.text: Customer asked if BMW has any specific charging guidelines compared with her Tesla, explaining she mainly wants to preserve the Battery's life. Writer advised that BMW recommends keeping the Battery level between about 10% and 80% and avoiding regular charges to 100%. Writer added she can charge to 100% when necessary, just not every time. Customer acknowledged this information.

G70-0395.text: my score would be a 10 if i had been informed there was a major recall on the car that cannot be fixed right now. i was really disappointed that nobody mentioned this.

G70-0401.text:
Customer reported that whenever he folds down the theater screen, the screen powers up and the video itself works fine, but there is no sound from the vehicle speakers with that video. Customer stated he then holds the radio volume knob to restart iDrive, and after that reboot the theater audio comes through the car speakers as it should.
Customer stated this problem has been happening since he bought the car. Customer stated he ran a Remote Software Upgrade yesterday, but the concern is still there. Customer stated he already brought it up with the dealer, but they did not carry out a full diagnostic or offer a lasting repair for the audio issue.
Writer advised that the dealer will need to perform further diagnosis on the concern.

G70-0403.text: my 2023 760 has been giving me issues and i'm still sitting here waiting on the compensation check my customer relations case manager said he was going to send.

G70-0412.text:
If there was one comment (positive or negative) about your new vehicle that you would allow us to share with your vehicle's manufacturer, what would you want to say to them?
: "I feel my BMW is safe, which I like, but the screen gets really hot and that makes me worry about safety."

G70-0419.text: Customer stated there is just not enough storage space anywhere in this vehicle.

G70-0425.text: Customer stated that the center console storage in the vehicle was too small. Customer stated that she was only able to fit a pair of sunglasses and one additional small item.

G70-0437.text: I had a very serious problem with Automatic engine stop-start problem: "when the car restarts it gives a jolt, and there's no way to shut off that economy start stop"

G70-0460.text: I had a minor problem with Built-in Bluetooth system - Frequent pairing/connectivity issues: "Display shows a message saying the blue tooth is outdated". Describe Bluetooth Problem: Won't find/authorize my mobile phone/device

G70-0470.text: Customer stated the air conditioning does not push much air, even when set to the maximum. Customer stated he wants the cold air to blow on him more noticeably.

G70-0471.text: not a fan of the blacked-out section around the grill, the angles seem a bit too sharp to me.. That is one thing could be most improved about the exterior styling of my new vehicle.

G70-0482.text: Customer stated he would like a spot to put his sunglasses. Writer advised him about BMW sunglass clips available online on our website and on Amazon.

G70-0485.text: Customer reported there is condensation building up in the headlights, and noted he has driven the vehicle roughly 200 miles so far.

G70-0491.text: Customer inquired whether she could use the IPA to handle navigation. Writer confirmed that navigation can be controlled through IPA and suggested using a voice command such as "Hello BMW. Open Navigation and take me to.." followed by the desired address or point of interest.

G70-0523.text: Customer stated they are unhappy with the present charging speeds when using public charging stations for both their i7 and iX vehicles. Customer mentioned they know about the recent announcement regarding access to the Tesla Supercharger network and intend to try that option.

G70-0556.text: Customer stated he does not feel this particular vehicle is the best match for him and that an X7 likely would have fit his needs better.

G70-0557.text: the first experience wasn't very good. the car showed up with a bad speaker, which was replaced later. about two weeks after we got it, the trunk latch failed, and the car had to be towed to service with the trunk stuck open. after a few days of waiting they replaced the latch.

G70-0583.text: i am very happy with this car in every way, from the overall style to the front grille, the rear of the car, the interior, and how the doors open and close. i do have one suggestion though: the set button and the number one and number two buttons are basically impossible to see in daylight or bright sun, since they only light up and become visible at night.

G70-0602.text: it's a great car, but with all the new digital icons and a not very well written manual, it takes much longer to really understand how all the functions work.

G70-0604.text: who thought it was a good idea to put a front license plate holder right in front of the iconic grill lights, blocking them. very disappointing and completely unnecessary.

G70-0627.text: Customer asked how to view feature videos and animations on the iDrive Control Display. Writer guided the customer to the iDrive Owner's Handbook and advised that the animations and video clips are only accessible when the vehicle is parked.

G70-0631.text: luxury is superior to mercedes benz. however, bmw clearly has tech problems that need to be addressed. we spent around $5000 for a tv in the rear seat and pay verizon every month for an esim in the car. whenever we get the esim working, the next time we try it, it has stopped functioning again. verizon shows it as active, the bmw app shows it as active, but the car still will not connect. issues like this make it harder for us to recommend the car to others.

G70-0648.text: Customer stated that adjusting the speed with the cruise control rocker switch is not easy, and that turning the feature on and off with the button is also difficult.

G70-0666.text: I had a problem with Parking cameras - Image is too small/poor quality: "It only displays what is straight behind the car. A wider angle view would help to spot any traffic coming from the sides."

G70-0686.text: Customer reports that their Samsung phone has trouble establishing a connection with the vehicle's interface.

G70-0698.text: Customer stated the theater screen is difficult to use. Customer mentioned the Firestick remedy and said the process was clumsy.

G70-0703.text: Customer stated that if they have a larger passenger in the front seat, they cannot fold down the theatre screen because the passenger is in the way.

G70-0705.text: i'm happy with everything about the car. my only issue is the screen, it glitches every now and then. i already had it updated once to see if that would fix it, but it didnt help. i live about 3 hours from the nearest dealer, so going back and forth is a hassle, and i dont know why it still keeps glitching.

G70-0706.text: I had a very serious problem with Center console - Squeak/rattle/other noise: "AC vent has a rattling sound. When I push it upward by hand the noise stops, but it keeps coming back sometimes."

G70-0732.text: i'd prefer if it had a bit more speed. also there are a couple of really bad rattles in the car.

G70-0742.text: I had a very minor problem with Adaptive cruise control - Alerts annoying/bothersome: "Using the Automated Driving System, it triggers alerts quickly if I glance anywhere but straight ahead."

G70-0749.text: the pricing on this car is way too high. i managed to negotiate a strong lease, but there is no chance i would spend the $190k msrp on an electric car that is bound to lose a lot of value. overall the tech is very solid, but bmw still not getting the esim to function correctly is incredibly annoying. one of the main reasons i chose this car was the theatre screen, and now it only operates if i run ugly cables to it. the seats are mostly comfortable, yet they do not give enough side bolster support, so i would really like more hold in the corners. the heated seats and heated armrests are fantastic and the infotainment works well, plus the upgraded sound system is outstanding. when using apple carplay, though, the bottom left corner with distance and time remaining is completely hidden behind my right hand while driving. if i swapped cars today i would rather be in an m5 touring.

G70-0780.text: Customer stated she used parking assist twice to pull into her garage and it failed both times, and she believes the garage may be too small. Writer advised the system requires adequate space on each side so it can maneuver safely.

G70-0804.text: I had a problem with Active parking assistance - DTU: "System wakes up, requests a destination, then fails to carry out the task."

G70-0816.text: the auto time zone adjustment just does not function. the radio also fails to quiet when i give carplay voice commands. with a 291 mile range, the actual distance i can use is heavily cut because i only charge between 20% and 80%. right now the public charging network feels both unreliable and not sufficiently available. every leg of a trip easily ends up with an extra hour added for each charging stop. i still dont know for sure, but if the battery life really proves to be just 8 years then this purchase will have been a poor investment. my insurance premium has shot up by about 200% even though the car has all this safety equipment. the explanation given is that repairing that safety tech after a crash costs a lot more, and the insurers claim there is not enough data yet to justify lowering the rates. sun glare or heavy rain seem to mess with the cameras trying to read the surroundings, and then the system basically chooses to shut itself off because it sees too much risk. when i drive on a road running parallel to train tracks, and a side street that crosses those tracks comes up, the railroad crossing lights aimed at the train get misread by the car as a stop light intended for my parallel road. there is also one set of traffic signals that the car reads as if they were a yield sign. the navigation does not let me set a preference for electrify america chargers when the planned distance exceeds the current charge; it just picks the first charger it finds. for at least the first 3 years, that electrify america selection option really should be there.

G70-0855.text: the car looks stunning, but the speakers don't get loud enough. on a 130k car, the audio should be both loud and really clear. the ambient light in the rear is much less bright than in the front, and the door plastics are already creaking.

G70-0879.text: Customer stated that when he initially saw the car from the outside, he felt the angles seemed harsh and that the overall look reminded him of a tank.

G70-0930.text: Customer reported the driving range is less than anticipated.

G70-0956.text:
the car rides amazingly smoothly, with superb handling and strong acceleration, really the ultimate driving machine. i like the styling inside and out and am glad i basically went with a fully loaded version. the kids love theater mode, and it lets me watch tv while i am at a charging station.

improvement areas are small: i would like more battery range, with around 350 miles or more on a full charge. the interactive screen setup works well but feels like it has almost too many choices, so it can take longer than i would like to get to what i need. finally, bluetooth and wifi are not always reliable, and roughly 20% of the time my phone cannot see the car wifi so carplay will not work.

G70-0959.text: Customer inquired about the release timing for the new X5 with iDrive 8. Customer then asked the writer to hold and never returned to the line.

G70-0987.text: i enjoy everything about this car, except the esim connection. it basically never works, and when i finally get it going it drops off again the next day. aside from that, the car is fantastic.

G70-0991.text: quietest, smoothest drive i have ever had, better than mercedes s. much easier to get in and out. b mode one pedal driving is super easy. no brake dust on the rims. interior looks unique and very luxurious, and the cloth seats are great. after about 3 months i still cant get esim working, and i need that for the tv theater. the range really needs to be better. all in all im happy with buying this car.

missing an opening sunroof,
front nose looks ridiculous,
way too much tech,

but overall still better than the mb 580 i came from.

while i actually prefer how the 7 series interior looks compared to the s class, i would still tell most family and friends to go with the s class instead, because of a mix of issues i've run into.

first, the premium audio: the top b&w setup is just so-so. for a "top of the line" system it doesn't stack up against the burmester premium system at all.

then the transmission behavior. when you really get on the throttle, the shifts in my 760i are noticeably rough. even my previous s63 amg, under heavy acceleration, shifted more smoothly than this car does.

the navigation software is another weak point. when driving in complicated road situations, it's not as intuitive or clear. it doesn't give enough early guidance for moving across several lanes on 6- or 8-lane city freeways, and it's not very clear about things like multi-lane exits where you need to pick a specific lane right after you exit. on top of that, the lane guidance is shown only in the hud, which feels like a bad design choice; those lane markers really should also show up on the main center display.

overall, the instrument screen behind the steering wheel is used poorly. both mercedes and audi handle that area much better, integrating it in a more sensible way with the center screen and hud, and audi especially is far ahead when it comes to how you can customize what's shown there.

the rear side window blinds are another disappointment, for two reasons. first, you have to go into the media screens to raise the shades, instead of them simply coming up automatically with a second press on the window raise hard button. second, the open channel where the side blinds sit looks unfinished. it comes across as unprofessional compared to what mercedes or audi do, where they have top covers hiding the blinds when they're stowed.

not being able to turn off auto start stop separately from the chosen drive mode is also annoying.

with the cruise control follow distance, there are two problems. you can't adjust the following gap while actually driving without digging through multiple menus, and even at the maximum setting the car follows too closely at moderate speeds. between about 45 and 60 mph, the farthest setting still feels uncomfortably, almost rudely, close to the car ahead.

the automatic lane keeping is behind the competition too. compared to audi and mercedes, it doesn't hold the lane as reliably or as smoothly, often failing to stay centered and tending to wander side to side. the lane keeping in this 760 really reminds me of mercedes' first generation system from something like 10 to 12 years ago.
